'''Chara Tull''' was the [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Pilot/Legends|co-pilot]] of [[Gerrol Hunn]] in the [[Stormhawks]] team during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They raced the [[Cloud City Grand Prix/Legends|Cloud City Grand Prix]] before the auction of the [[Jewel of Yavin/Legends|Jewel of Yavin]].
